Third-party code used by the stand-in avatar builder (src/standin_maker.cpp):

- `lzma/`: LZMA decoder from the 7-Zip / LZMA SDK by Igor Pavlov
  (https://github.com/ip7z/7zip, `C/`), public domain.
- `stb/stb_image.h`: stb_image v2.29 by Sean Barrett
  (https://github.com/nothings/stb), public domain / MIT.
